about.headline: Hi, I'm Cait.
paragraphs: I spent years at Amazon wearing a lot of hats — web development, marketing, product — and somewhere in between all of it, I figured out what I actually love: building things from scratch that feel genuinely beautiful and uniquely yours.

Corporate work taught me a lot, but it also made something clear. Small businesses have more heart, more story, and more personality than any big brand. The problem is most of their websites don't show it.

That's what The CB Creative is for. I bring the design eye, the development skills, and the marketing instincts to build websites that don't just look good — they pull people in and make them feel something.

whyNotAI.headline:
Why not just
use AI?
whyNotAI.intro: AI can spin up a boilerplate template in seconds. But it can't sit with you, learn your values, find your distinction, or design for your actual target.
whyNotAI.body: I use AI tools every single day — which means I know exactly where they fall short. Generic layouts. Off-brand copy. No real strategy. What I build for you is specific to you: your story, your market, your goals.

faq.question: AI builds for the average.
faq.answer: I build directly for you — your brand, your distinct voice, and your specific local customer demographic.

faq.question: Optimized for the future.
faq.answer: Every site I code is built with search and AI engine accessibility (AEO) to make sure you get surfaced when people search.

faq.question: A collaborative partner.
faq.answer: You get a real human being to brainstorm with, solve design challenges, and iterate alongside.

faq.question: I know when to put the tools down.
faq.answer: I use AI tools every day — I just know exactly when to put them down and do the work myself.

whyNotAI.closing: If you wanted average, you wouldn't be here.
